blocks.text: The lighthouse repeats the pet’s signal at receding angles.
Appearance: Godot draws three translucent copies of the current pet frame in different directions. Reduced motion holds them still.
Care: Calm care, rest, and stress medicine.
Story connection: A future signal puzzle could distinguish a real distress call from its copies.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.
